meta.title: Surah Al-Baqarah (1-30) Grammar Sample
notes: Sample educational dataset with concise grammar notes.
Focus: fragments, sentence structure, particles, verb patterns, and rhetorical syntax.
Designed for human review and extension into deeper word-by-word i`rab.

ayahs.translation_en: Alif. Lam. Mim.

fragments.explanation: Huruf muqattaat; isolated letters that open the surah.

grammar_aspects.label: Huruf Muqattaat
grammar_aspects.note: These letters are recited by letter-name, not parsed as a normal sentence.

grammar_aspects.label: No I`rab Position
grammar_aspects.note: Treated as an independent Quranic opening unit.

ayahs.arabic: ذٰلِكَ الۡڪِتٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛۚۖ فِيۡهِۛۚ هُدًى لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation_en: THIS DIVINE WRIT - let there be no doubt about it is [meant to be] a guidance for all the God-conscious.

fragments.explanation: Negation of doubt in the Book.

grammar_aspects.label: Ism Isharah
grammar_aspects.note: Far demonstrative used for honor and elevation.

grammar_aspects.label: La Nafiyah (Negation)
grammar_aspects.note: Negates the existence of any doubt.

grammar_aspects.label: Jar-Majroor
grammar_aspects.note: Preposition + attached pronoun / preposition + plural noun.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation_en: Who believe in [the existence of] that which is beyond the reach of human perception, and are constant in prayer, and spend on others out of what We provide for them as sustenance;

fragments.explanation: Traits of the muttaqeen begin with belief in the unseen.
Imperfect verb indicates regular establishment of prayer.
Spending from provision given by Allah.

grammar_aspects.label: Mudari` Verbs
grammar_aspects.note: Imperfect plural verbs show recurring actions.

grammar_aspects.label: Min + Ma
grammar_aspects.note: Combined preposition with relative/indefinite ma: from what We provided.

ayahs.arabic: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِمَۤا اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ وَمَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۚ وَبِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.translation_en: And who believe in that which has been bestowed from on high upon thee, [O Prophet,] as well as in that which was bestowed before thy time: for it is they who in their innermost are certain of the life to come!

fragments.explanation: Belief in what was revealed to Prophet Muhammad.

grammar_aspects.label: Passive Perfect Verb
grammar_aspects.note: Form IV passive perfect: was sent down.

grammar_aspects.label: Pronoun of Separation/Emphasis
grammar_aspects.note: Adds exclusivity and emphasis before the verb.

ayahs.arabic: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ عَلٰى هُدًى مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ​ وَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: It is they who follow the guidance [which comes from their Sustainer; and it is they, they who' shall attain to a happy state!

fragments.explanation: Those people are upon guidance from their Lord.

grammar_aspects.label: Ism Isharah (Plural)
grammar_aspects.note: Used twice for emphasis and distinction.

grammar_aspects.label: Hasr-style Emphasis
grammar_aspects.note: Pronoun + definite predicate gives strong restriction.

ayahs.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: BEHOLD, as for those who are bent on denying the truth - it is all one to them whether thou warnest them or dost not warn them: they will not believe.

fragments.explanation: Whether you warn or do not warn.

ayahs.arabic: خَتَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَعَلٰى سَمۡعِهِمۡ​ؕ وَعَلٰىٓ اَبۡصَارِهِمۡ غِشَاوَةٌ  وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation_en: God; has sealed their hearts and their hearing, and over their eyes is a veil; and awesome suffering awaits them.

fragments.explanation: Perfect verb with explicit subject Allah.
A covering is over their vision.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَبِالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِ وَمَا هُمۡ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ​ۘ‏
ayahs.translation_en: And there are people who say, "We do believe in God and the Last Day," the while they do not [really] believe.

fragments.explanation: From the people is one who says...

grammar_aspects.label: Ba of Emphatic Negation
grammar_aspects.note: Extra ba after ma strengthens denial.

ayahs.arabic: يُخٰدِعُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا ​ۚ وَمَا يَخۡدَعُوۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.translation_en: They would deceive God and those who have attained to faith-the while they deceive none but themselves, and perceive it not.

fragments.explanation: Attempted deception toward Allah and believers.

grammar_aspects.label: Reflexive Object
grammar_aspects.note: Object refers back to the subject.

ayahs.arabic: فِىۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌۙ فَزَادَهُمُ اللّٰهُ مَرَضًا ​ۚ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌۙۢبِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡذِبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: In their hearts is disease, and so God lets their disease increase; and grievous suffering awaits them because of their persistent lying.

grammar_aspects.label: Fa of Consequence
grammar_aspects.note: Links prior condition with resulting increase.

ayahs.arabic: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِۙ قَالُوۡاۤ اِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: And when they are told, "Do not spread corruption on earth," they answer, "We are but improving things!"

fragments.explanation: Whenever it is said to them...
They claim: we are only reformers.

ayahs.arabic: اَلَا ۤ اِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡمُفۡسِدُوۡنَ وَلٰـكِنۡ لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: Oh, verily, it is they, they who are spreading corruption but they perceive it not?

fragments.explanation: Attention: they are truly the corrupters.

grammar_aspects.label: Lakinna/But Contrast
grammar_aspects.note: Shifts from fact to their inner blindness.

ayahs.arabic: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اٰمِنُوۡا كَمَاۤ اٰمَنَ النَّاسُ قَالُوۡاۤ اَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَاۤ اٰمَنَ السُّفَهَآءُ​ ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ السُّفَهَآءُ وَلٰـكِنۡ لَّا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: And when they are told, "Believe as other people believe," they answer, "Shall we believe as the weak-minded believe?" Oh, verily, it is they, they who are weak-minded -but they know it not!

fragments.explanation: Shall we believe like the foolish?

grammar_aspects.label: Rhetorical Istifham
grammar_aspects.note: Question used for rejection, not seeking info.

ayahs.arabic: وَاِذَا لَقُوۡا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا قَالُوۡاۤ اٰمَنَّا ۖۚ وَاِذَا خَلَوۡا اِلٰى شَيٰطِيۡنِهِمۡۙ قَالُوۡاۤ اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡۙ اِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: And when they meet those who have attained to faith, they assert, "We believe [as you believe]"; but when they find themselves alone with their- evil impulses, they say, "Verily, we are with you; we were only mocking!"

grammar_aspects.label: Ism Fa`il
grammar_aspects.note: Active participle indicates established mocking trait.

ayahs.arabic: اَللّٰهُ يَسۡتَهۡزِئُ بِهِمۡ وَيَمُدُّهُمۡ فِىۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: God will requite them for their mockery, and will leave them for a while in their overweening arrogance, blindly stumbling to and fro:

fragments.explanation: They are left to extend in transgression.

ayahs.arabic: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اشۡتَرَوُا الضَّلٰلَةَ بِالۡهُدٰى فَمَا رَبِحَتۡ تِّجَارَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُهۡتَدِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: [for] it is they who have taken error in exchange for guidance; and neither has their bargain brought them gain, nor have they found guidance [elsewhere].

fragments.explanation: Metaphor of trade: error for guidance.

ayahs.arabic: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِى اسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارًا ​ۚ فَلَمَّاۤ اَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهٗ ذَهَبَ اللّٰهُ بِنُوۡرِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِىۡ ظُلُمٰتٍ لَّا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: Their parable is that of people who kindle a fire: but as soon as it has illumined all around them, God takes away their light and leaves them in utter darkness, wherein they cannot see:

fragments.arabic: فَلَمَّاۤ اَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهٗ ذَهَبَ اللّٰهُ
بِنُوۡرِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِىۡ ظُلُمٰتٍ لَّا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿

ayahs.arabic: صُمٌّۢ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡىٌ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation_en: Deaf, dumb, blind - and they cannot turn back.

grammar_aspects.label: Compressed Predication
grammar_aspects.note: Series of predicates without explicit mubtada.

ayahs.arabic: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ وَّرَعۡدٌ وَّبَرۡقٌ​ ۚ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِىۡۤ اٰذَانِهِمۡ مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الۡمَوۡتِ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُحِيۡطٌ​ۢ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: Or [the parable] of a violent cloudburst in the sky, with utter darkness, thunder and lightning: they put their fingers into their ears to keep out the peals of thunder, in terror of death; but God encompasses [with His might] all who deny the truth.

fragments.arabic: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ
اٰذَانِهِمۡ مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الۡمَوۡتِ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُحِيۡطٌ​ۢ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
fragments.explanation: They put fingers in ears from thunderclaps.

grammar_aspects.label: Aw for Alternative Parable
grammar_aspects.evidence: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ

grammar_aspects.label: Plural Sound Feminine?
grammar_aspects.evidence: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ
grammar_aspects.note: Broken plural carrying intensity of layered darkness.

grammar_aspects.label: Min for Cause
grammar_aspects.evidence: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ

ayahs.arabic: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ​ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا فِيۡهِۙ وَاِذَاۤ اَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُوۡا​ؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصَارِهِمۡ​ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
ayahs.translation_en: The lightning well-nigh takes away their sight; whenever it gives them light, they advance therein, and whenever darkness falls around them, they stand still. And if God so willed, He could indeed take away their hearing and their sight: for, verily, God has the power to will anything.

fragments.arabic: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ​ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا
فِيۡهِۙ وَاِذَاۤ اَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُوۡا​ؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ
fragments.explanation: Whenever lit, they walk in it.

fragments.arabic: لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصَارِهِمۡ​ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏

grammar_aspects.label: Kada Verb
grammar_aspects.evidence: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ​ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا

grammar_aspects.label: Kullama Repetition
grammar_aspects.evidence: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ​ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا

grammar_aspects.label: Law + Past Verb Hypothetical
grammar_aspects.evidence: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡ​ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا

ayahs.arabic: يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعۡبُدُوۡا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُوۡنَ ۙ‏
ayahs.translation_en: O MANKIND! Worship your Sustainer, who has created you and those who lived before you, so that you might remain conscious of Him

fragments.explanation: Reason: Creator of you and those before you.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخۡرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزۡقًا لَّـكُمۡ​ۚ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا وَّاَنۡـتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ‏
ayahs.translation_en: who has made the earth a resting-place for you and the sky a canopy, and has sent down water from the sky and thereby brought forth fruits for your sustenance: do not, then, claim that there is any power that could rival God, when you know [that He is One].

fragments.arabic: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنۡزَلَ
مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخۡرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزۡقًا
لَّـكُمۡ​ۚ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا وَّاَنۡـتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ‏

grammar_aspects.label: Ja`ala with Two Objects
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنۡزَلَ
grammar_aspects.note: Transformative verb taking object + resulting state.

grammar_aspects.label: Fa Sequential
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنۡزَلَ
grammar_aspects.note: Transition to consequence of sending rain.

grammar_aspects.label: Prohibition + Object
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّاَنۡزَلَ
grammar_aspects.note: Negative imperative: do not set rivals.

ayahs.arabic: وَاِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰى عَبۡدِنَا فَاۡتُوۡا بِسُوۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ وَادۡعُوۡا شُهَدَآءَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: And if you doubt any part of what We have, bestowed from on high, step by step, upon Our servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah of similar merit, and call upon any other than God to bear witness for you -if what you say is true!

fragments.arabic: وَاِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰى
عَبۡدِنَا فَاۡتُوۡا بِسُوۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ وَادۡعُوۡا شُهَدَآءَكُمۡ
fragments.explanation: About what We revealed to Our servant.

fragments.arabic: مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿

grammar_aspects.label: Conditional In
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰى

grammar_aspects.label: Amr Verb in Argument
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰى

grammar_aspects.label: Command to Witnesses
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰى

ayahs.arabic: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُوۡا وَلَنۡ تَفۡعَلُوۡا فَاتَّقُوۡا النَّارَ الَّتِىۡ وَقُوۡدُهَا النَّاسُ وَالۡحِجَارَةُ  ۖۚ اُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: And if you cannot do it-and most certainly you cannot do it-then be conscious of the fire whose fuel is human beings and stones which awaits all who deny the truth!

fragments.explanation: If you do not do it.
And you will never do it.

grammar_aspects.label: Ittaqu as Imperative
grammar_aspects.note: Command built on Form VIII root w-q-y.

ayahs.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ​ؕ ڪُلَّمَا رُزِقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مِنۡ ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزۡقًا ​ۙ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ رُزِقۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَاُتُوۡا بِهٖ مُتَشَابِهًا ​ؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَآ اَزۡوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ​ۙ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: But unto those who have attained to faith and do good works give the glad tiding that theirs shall be gardens through which running waters flow. Whenever they are granted fruits there from as their appointed sustenance, they will say, "It is this that in days of yore was granted to us as our sustenance!"-for they shall be given something that will recall that [past]. And there shall they have spouses pure, and there shall they abide.

fragments.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا
fragments.explanation: Give glad tidings to believers who do righteous deeds.

fragments.arabic: الۡاَنۡهٰرُ​ؕ ڪُلَّمَا رُزِقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مِنۡ ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزۡقًا ​ۙ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ رُزِقۡنَا
مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَاُتُوۡا بِهٖ مُتَشَابِهًا ​ؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَآ اَزۡوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ​ۙ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ‏

grammar_aspects.label: Bashshir Imperative
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا

grammar_aspects.label: Passive Perfect
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا

grammar_aspects.label: Purified Spouses Expression
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا

ayahs.arabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡـىٖۤ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ​بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ​ؕ فَاَمَّا ​الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهُ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ​ۚ وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ڪَفَرُوۡا فَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَاذَآ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهٖ ڪَثِيۡرًا وَّيَهۡدِىۡ بِهٖ كَثِيۡرًا ​ؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهٖۤ اِلَّا الۡفٰسِقِيۡنَۙ ‏
ayahs.translation_en: Behold, God does not disdain to propound a parable of a gnat, or of something [even] less than that. Now, as for those who have attained to faith, they know that it is the truth from their Sustainer - whereas those who are bent on denying the truth say, "What could God mean by this parable?" In this way does He cause many a one to go astray, just as He guides many a one aright: but none does He cause thereby to go astray save the iniquitous,

fragments.arabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡـىٖۤ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ​بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ​ؕ فَاَمَّا ​الَّذِيۡنَ
fragments.explanation: Allah does not shy from striking a parable.

fragments.arabic: اٰمَنُوۡا فَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهُ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ​ۚ وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ڪَفَرُوۡا فَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَاذَآ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا
fragments.explanation: Any example, even of a mosquito or above it.

fragments.arabic: مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهٖ ڪَثِيۡرًا وَّيَهۡدِىۡ بِهٖ كَثِيۡرًا ​ؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهٖۤ اِلَّا الۡفٰسِقِيۡنَۙ ‏
fragments.explanation: Believers know it is truth from their Lord.

grammar_aspects.label: An + Mudari` Complement
grammar_aspects.evidence: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡـىٖۤ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ​بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ​ؕ فَاَمَّا ​الَّذِيۡنَ

grammar_aspects.label: Ma as Indefinite Magnifier
grammar_aspects.evidence: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡـىٖۤ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ​بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ​ؕ فَاَمَّا ​الَّذِيۡنَ

grammar_aspects.label: Contrastive Fa-amma
grammar_aspects.evidence: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡـىٖۤ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا ​بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَا ​ؕ فَاَمَّا ​الَّذِيۡنَ
grammar_aspects.note: Divides response of believers and disbelievers.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مِيۡثَاقِهٖ وَيَقۡطَعُوۡنَ مَآ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهٖۤ اَنۡ يُّوۡصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ​ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: who break their bond with God after it has been established [in their nature], and cut asunder what God has bidden to be joined, and spread corruption on earth: these it is that shall be the losers.

fragments.arabic: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ
مِيۡثَاقِهٖ وَيَقۡطَعُوۡنَ مَآ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهٖۤ
fragments.explanation: Sever what Allah commanded to be joined.

fragments.arabic: اَنۡ يُّوۡصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ​ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ‏

grammar_aspects.label: Post-Covenant Phrase
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ
grammar_aspects.note: Temporal prepositional phrase after firm covenant.

grammar_aspects.label: Passive Mudari`
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ
grammar_aspects.note: To be joined; passive focus on duty itself.

grammar_aspects.label: Nominal Conclusion
grammar_aspects.evidence: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ

ayahs.arabic: كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَڪُنۡتُمۡ اَمۡوَاتًا فَاَحۡيَاکُمۡ​ۚ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation_en: How can you refuse to acknowledge God, seeing that you were lifeless and He gave you life, and that He will cause you to die and then will bring you again to life, whereupon unto Him you will be brought back?

fragments.explanation: How can you disbelieve in Allah?
You were dead then He gave life.
Death, life, then return to Him.

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ مَّا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰۤى اِلَى السَّمَآءِ فَسَوّٰٮهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ​ؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: He it is who has created for you all that is on earth, and has applied His design to the heavens and fashioned them into seven heavens; and He alone has full knowledge of everything.

fragments.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ مَّا فِى
fragments.explanation: He created all that is on earth for you.

fragments.arabic: الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰۤى اِلَى السَّمَآءِ
fragments.explanation: Then He turned to/rose toward the heaven.

fragments.arabic: فَسَوّٰٮهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ​ؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏ ﻿﻿

grammar_aspects.label: Huwa + Relative Clause
grammar_aspects.evidence: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ مَّا فِى
grammar_aspects.note: Identity statement with explanatory relative clause.

grammar_aspects.label: Jami`an as Hal
grammar_aspects.evidence: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ مَّا فِى

grammar_aspects.label: Sab`a as Number + Tamyiz
grammar_aspects.evidence: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ لَـكُمۡ مَّا فِى

ayahs.arabic: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ جَاعِلٌ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ خَلِيۡفَةً ؕ قَالُوۡٓا اَتَجۡعَلُ فِيۡهَا مَنۡ يُّفۡسِدُ فِيۡهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ الدِّمَآءَۚ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَـكَ​ؕ قَالَ اِنِّىۡٓ اَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation_en: AND LO! Thy Sustainer said unto the angels: "Behold, I am about to establish upon earth one who shall inherit it." They said: "Wilt Thou place on it such as will spread corruption thereon and shed blood -whereas it is we who extol Thy limitless glory, and praise Thee, and hallow Thy name?" [God] answered: "Verily, I know that which you do not know."

fragments.arabic: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ جَاعِلٌ فِى
fragments.explanation: Recall when your Lord said to the angels.

fragments.arabic: الۡاَرۡضِ خَلِيۡفَةً ؕ قَالُوۡٓا اَتَجۡعَلُ فِيۡهَا مَنۡ
fragments.explanation: I am placing a vicegerent in the earth.

fragments.arabic: يُّفۡسِدُ فِيۡهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ الدِّمَآءَۚ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ
fragments.explanation: Will You place one who corrupts and sheds blood?

fragments.arabic: وَنُقَدِّسُ لَـكَ​ؕ قَالَ اِنِّىۡٓ اَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
fragments.explanation: I know what you do not know.

grammar_aspects.label: Idh Narrative Particle
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ جَاعِلٌ فِى
grammar_aspects.note: Calls the listener to a past scene.

grammar_aspects.label: Ism Fa`il
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ جَاعِلٌ فِى

grammar_aspects.label: Ma Mausulah in Knowledge Contrast
grammar_aspects.evidence: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةِ اِنِّىۡ جَاعِلٌ فِى
